results.title: The 'Burbs Season 2 Cast Updates: RJ Cyler Promoted to Series Regular
results.description: The 'Burbs Season 2 casting news reveals RJ Cyler promotion and new recurring guest stars Daniel Ezra, Retta, and Vincent Kartheiser join the cast alongside Elizabeth Hurley.

results.title: CEOs James Gunn and Peter Safran stepping down after sudden DCU shakeup
results.description: Co-CEOs of DC Studios James Gunn and Peter Safran announced they are stepping down from their leadership roles after a string of hits in the new DC Universe.

results.title: Lynda Jolly
results.description: Lynda June Jolly, 74, of Ranchester, Wyoming passed away peacefully on Friday, November 6, 2026 at her home, with her loving family at her side. No Services to be announced. Online condolences may be written at https://www.kanefuneral.com/. Champion Kane Funeral Home has been entrusted with local arrangements.…

results.title: 67th Festival of Lessons & Carols
results.description: The Hotchkiss Chorus presents the 67th annual Festival of Lessons & Carols on Sunday, December 6, at 7:00 p.m. in the Hotchkiss Chapel. This beloved holiday tradition features an evening of beautiful choral music, including classic a cappella carols and contemporary works by English and American composers. Led by faculty member Jack Brown, with Joe Rose on the Chapel organ and Chaplain Jason Larson leading the service, the program also invites audience members to join in singing traditional carols. The evening concludes with the cherished candlelight singing of “Silent Night.” Free and open to the public. All are welcome, and guests are encouraged to arrive early to ensure seating.
